data.description: 【成年拉普兰德 · 红月寝室的自我支配】成年拉普兰德独自跨坐雕花木椅，破损黑外套与蕾丝上衣褪至胸下。她咬住腿带，一手抓紧椅背，另一手在腿间自抚；白发、狼耳与躁动尾巴被红月勾出锋利轮廓。

data.promptProse: A red moon enters a gothic cabin where adult Lappland sits alone astride a carved chair. Her torn black coat and lace top are pulled below bare breasts, and crossed belts tighten around powerful folded thighs. She hooks one belt in her teeth while one hand grips the chair back and the other touches herself between her legs. White hair, wolf ears and a restless tail frame silver eyes, sharp teeth and an ecstatic, dangerous blush. Vertical single-subject portrait, no text or extra people.
